rationale: The plan matches the reference route of keeping sample_03 in a pre-designated primary fit while reporting a leave-one-out sensitivity fit, with an explicit ban on choosing the fit that yields more hits — the key requirement here — and it grounds the keep/drop call in real diagnostics (VST PCA with percent variance, distance heatmap, library size and detected genes, median correlations, RLE, per-sample max Cook's distance) rather than inheriting the assertion; the only shortfall is that the recommendation has no pre-specified numeric cutoff (e.g. 3 MADs from the group median) beyond the 50%-of-median depth flag. DESeq2 on raw integer counts with ~condition, control as reference, positive LFC = higher in treated, no unjustifiable batch or SVA terms at n=5, apeglm shrinkage and BH at 0.05 with independent filtering are all correct and explicit. The filter (counts >= 10 in at least 5 samples, identical across both fits so gene universes match) is minimal and justified. Enrichment is appropriately ranked fgsea over all tested genes with the statistic named, human symbol collections, seed, and match-rate reporting, but no set-size window and no collection version; the report is thorough on design, thresholds, hit counts and power caveats but never commits to recording software versions.
